name: LMR36510
description: 65 V, 1 A synchronous buck with power-good and 26 µA quiescent current, a small rugged 5 V/3.3 V logic supply for 48 V systems.
notes: Rated 65 V with 70 V transient protection: OK for 13S Li-ion (54.6 V).
Pin-compatible with LMR36520 (2 A) and the LMR3361x/LMR3362x/LMR3363x family.
Output adjustable from 1 V to 28 V (datasheet recommended maximum).

en.note: Pin table: 'Can be connected directly to VIN; do not float.' EN abs max 70.3 V (VIN abs max 70 V); rec. op. EN <= VIN + 0.3 V. Precision enable: VEN-VOUT-H 1.231 V typ rising (1.157-1.3), 110 mV hysteresis; VEN-VCC-H 1.14 V (VCC on, standby), VEN-VCC-L 0.3 V (shutdown). Optional UVLO divider (Eq. 10): RENB 10-100 kΩ, RENT = (VON/VEN-H - 1)*RENB, VOFF = VON*(1 - VEN-HYS/VEN-H).

pg.note: Open-drain. Pull up to a logic rail, VCC or VOUT; from VCC a 10-100 kΩ pull-up is recommended (sec. 8.2.1.2.7). Rec. op. max 18 V, never above VIN + 0.3 V. Limit sink current to <= 4 mA. Unused: pin table says 'can be left open', but sec. 7.3.1 says 'must be grounded' (datasheet contradicts itself; grounding is the safe choice). Low below 93 % / high above 107 % of VFB, 1.5 % hysteresis; ~4 ms delay at start-up; forced low when EN low.

extras.note: Internal 5 V LDO output; requires a high-quality 1 µF, 16 V ceramic to PGND. Do not load (a PG pull-up is OK).

notes: Peak-current-mode, internally compensated, fixed 400 kHz (340-460). LMR36510ADDAR = auto PFM/PWM (diode emulation at light load); LMR36510FADDAR = FPWM. 4.5 ms internal soft start; hiccup if FB < 0.4 V in current limit.

tON-MIN 92 ns typ, tOFF-MIN 80 ns typ (102 max), tON-MAX 7 µs; DMAX 98 % (system spec, frequency folds back to ~140 kHz in dropout). Frequency also folds back once tON-MIN is reached: VIN <= VOUT/(tON*fSW) (Eq. 2).

Current limits: high-side ISC 2.0 A typ (1.6-2.4), low-side valley ILS-LIMIT 1.3 A typ (1.0-1.6). Max load (Eq. 1): IOUT(max) = ILIMIT + (VIN - VOUT)/(2*fSW*L) * VOUT/VIN. Inductor Isat ideally >= ISC, never below ILIMIT.

Inductor (Eq. 4): L = (VIN - VOUT)/(fSW*K*IOUTmax) * VOUT/VIN, K = 0.2-0.4 (0.3 best; design example µses K = 0.4 at 24 V in -> 24.7 µH -> 22 µH). Use the device max current (1 A). Subharmonic limit (Eq. 5): LMIN >= 0.625*VOUT/fSW (H, Hz).

Output caps: ceramic X7R or better, effective values. Same COUT / ESR equations as LMR33630 (Eq. 6): COUT >= dIOUT/(fSW*dVOUT*K) * [(1-D)*(1+K) + K^2/12*(2-D)]. Max total COUT ~10x the design value or 1000 µF, whichever is smaller. Table 8-1 also lists minimum (size-optimised) COUT: 3.3 V 2x22 µF, 5 V 1x22 µF, 12 V 2x10 µF; the lTable µses the nominal (transient-optimised) values.

Feedback: RFBT 100 kΩ recommended (max 1 MΩ), RFBB = RFBT/(VOUT/VREF - 1). CFF 'None' in Table 8-1; mandatory if RFBT = 1 MΩ. Starting value (Eq. 9): CFF < VOUT*COUT / (120*RFBT*sqrt(VREF/VOUT)). Note: the application-curve BOM (Table 8-4) µses different dividers (3.3 V: 46.4k/20k; 5 V: 34k+46.4k/20k).

Input: >= 2.2 µF ceramic required (example 2.2 µF 100 V X7R), rated >= max VIN (preferably 2x), plus a small-case 220 nF 100 V X7R as close as possible to the IC. IRMS ~ IOUT/2. Optional 20-100 µF electrolytic for long input leads.
CBOOT: 100 nF, >= 16 V, BOOT to SW. Max die temperature 150 C. Do not let VOUT exceed VIN or go below ground.

Catalog check: datasheet rec. op. VOUT is 1-28 V (features list '1 V to 95 % of VIN'; TI product page says 62 V). Catalog voutMax 62 V matches the product page, not the rec. op. table. VIN 4.2-65 V, 1 A, 400 kHz agree.
